name: morning
example: The street is quiet in the morning.
exampleTranslation: 早晨这条街很安静。

name: evening
example: We walk by the river in the evening.
exampleTranslation: 我们傍晚在河边散步。

name: water
example: There is fresh water in the bottle.
exampleTranslation: 瓶子里有新鲜的水。

name: bread
example: I put the warm bread on a plate.
exampleTranslation: 我把温热的面包放在盘子上。

name: apple
example: She shared an apple with her brother.
exampleTranslation: 她和弟弟分吃了一个苹果。

name: table
example: The little plant is on the table.
exampleTranslation: 那盆小植物在桌子上。

name: window
example: Open the window for a little air.
exampleTranslation: 打开窗户透透气。

name: garden
example: Two birds are resting in our garden.
exampleTranslation: 两只鸟正在我们的花园里歇息。

name: friend
example: My friend brings a new board game.
exampleTranslation: 我的朋友带来一个新的桌游。

name: family
example: My family cooks together on Sunday.
exampleTranslation: 星期天我们一家人一起做饭。

name: walk
example: I walk to the shop with a bag.
exampleTranslation: 我提着袋子步行去商店。

name: open
example: Open the small box on the shelf.
exampleTranslation: 打开架子上的小盒子。

name: close
example: Close the door when you leave.
exampleTranslation: 离开时把门关上。

name: choose
example: Choose a color for your notebook.
exampleTranslation: 给你的笔记本选一个颜色。

name: carry
example: I carry a pencil in my pocket.
exampleTranslation: 我口袋里带着一支铅笔。

name: small
example: A small boat waits near the bridge.
exampleTranslation: 一艘小船停在桥边。

name: quiet
example: We found a quiet place to read.
exampleTranslation: 我们找到了一个安静的地方读书。

name: ready
example: I am ready for a short walk.
exampleTranslation: 我准备好去散一小会儿步了。

name: useful
example: This map is useful on our trip.
exampleTranslation: 这张地图在我们的旅途中很有用。

name: together
example: Let us make a simple meal together.
exampleTranslation: 我们一起做顿简单的饭吧。
